title: Hanuman's Great Leap
narration: Hanuman stood at the edge of the mountain. Then he leapt across the endless sea. At last, Lanka appeared before him.

scenes.visual_description: Hanuman stands on a mountain cliff overlooking the ocean.
scenes.narration_segment: Hanuman stood at the edge of the mountain.

scenes.visual_description: Hanuman flies above the wide blue ocean.
scenes.action: Hanuman leaps and flies across the waves
scenes.narration_segment: Then he leapt across the endless sea.

scenes.visual_description: Hanuman sees the golden city of Lanka on the horizon.
scenes.action: Hanuman looks toward the distant city
scenes.narration_segment: At last, Lanka appeared before him.
